deal_name: Nordbyte Logistics — AI SDR Risk Pilot

emails.subject: Quick intro — reducing lead drop-offs at Nordbyte
emails.body:
Hi Alex,

Came across Nordbyte while looking at logistics teams scaling inbound sales.

We’re working with RevOps teams to identify where leads stall or silently drop out of the funnel — especially between first contact and qualification.

Worth a short intro call to see if this is relevant for you?

Best,
Maya

emails.subject: Re: Quick intro — reducing lead drop-offs at Nordbyte
emails.body:
Hi Maya,

Sorry for the slow reply — been swamped.

This looks interesting. Happy to learn more — we’re exploring a couple options around funnel visibility.

Can you share a bit more on how you approach this?

Alex

emails.subject: Re: Quick intro — reducing lead drop-offs at Nordbyte
emails.body:
Sure.

In short: we analyze real SDR communication (emails + meetings) and surface risk patterns — slow response times, unclear next steps, soft objections, internal dependencies.

Teams use this to catch deals that *look alive* in CRM but are drifting in intent.

If helpful, happy to walk through a concrete example in ~20 min.

Maya

emails.subject: Following up
emails.body:
Hi Alex,

Just checking if a short intro makes sense on your side.

Maya

emails.subject: Re: Following up
emails.body:
Hey Maya,

Yeah, let’s do a quick call. Early next week should work.

Just to set expectations: I’m not the final decision maker — Procurement usually runs vendor onboarding and InfoSec will weigh in. I can intro you to our IT lead if we decide to keep going.

Alex

emails.subject: Re: Following up
emails.body:
Great, thanks.

How does Tuesday or Wednesday look?

Maya

emails.subject: Scheduling
emails.body:
Hi Alex,

Just looping back on timing for our call.

Would Thu 10:00 UTC work for a quick 20-minute intro?

Maya

emails.subject: Re: Scheduling
emails.body:
Sorry for the delay. Thu 10:00 UTC works.

Alex

emails.subject: Invite — Intro call
emails.body:
Perfect. Sending a calendar invite for Thu 10:00 UTC now.

Looping in Sam from our side as well.

Maya

emails.subject: Next steps
emails.body:
Hi Alex,

Thanks again for the conversation earlier.

As promised, here’s a short summary + example dashboard.

No rush, but when you have a minute: does this feel like something on your roadmap this quarter, or more “when capacity frees up”?

And if it makes sense, happy to include the business owner on a future check-in once the process side is clearer.

Either way, feel free to forward to Procurement/InfoSec if it’s helpful.

Maya

emails.subject: Following up on next steps
emails.body:
Hi Alex,

Wanted to check if you had a chance to review the summary.

If helpful, we can do a quick 15-min check-in tomorrow (Tue) at 14:00 UTC to align on timeline + process.

Maya

emails.subject: Re: Following up on next steps
emails.body:
Hey Maya,

Thanks. Still discussing internally.

This is on our roadmap, but timing is unclear right now (Q1 is packed). Hard to say what success would look like yet.

Tue 14:00 UTC works for a quick check-in.

Alex
